tools.name: cross_check
tools.description: Cross-check ONE factual claim against a verified knowledge graph BEFORE you assert it — the "am I sure?" instant, just before a discrete fact leaves your mouth. Prefer this over stating such a fact from memory. Its whole job is to catch your own hallucination before it reaches the user: every call e

tools.name: verify_claims
tools.description:
Cross-check MANY claims at once — sanity-check a whole draft or answer before you commit to it.
    Pass a list of {subject, relation, value, hint}; get one verdict per claim (see cross_check).
    Ideal as a final pass over anything factual you're about to output.

tools.name: lookup_facts
tools.description:
Get the verified facts known about an entity, each with a source — to ground a statement or see
    what's actually established before you write. subject: a name or QID; hint: a disambiguator.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "cross_check" is 4773 chars, far longer than this server's median (265). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
